_comment: Copy this somewhere OUTSIDE the repo and point HOUSECARL_HARNESS_CONFIG at it. This repo is the tool and is meant to be shared; a config naming your MO2 instance, profile and drive layout is a fact about YOUR mod setup and belongs with it. (It is found only through that variable; the probes run from a build folder and search for no config file.) Use FORWARD slashes: Windows accepts them and a lone backslash is an invalid JSON escape. Every key is optional — a probe only requires the ones it uses. Precedence: the probe's own flags (--instance, --profile, --game, --roots) beat the environment (HOUSECARL_MO2_INSTANCE / _MO2_PROFILE / _GAME_PATH / _DOWNLOAD_POOL / _SEVENZIP / _SEARCH_ROOTS), which beat this file. Exception: "instance" here is never used as a default — a probe given no --instance (or HOUSECARL_MO2_INSTANCE) refuses with instance-not-explicit — and "game"/"profile" here are used only when the run's instance is this one. HOUSECARL_MO2_INSTANCE counts only when set for the run, not persisted at User/Machine level (instance-env-persistent). "primitiveSolidity" is a measured collision-marker table (stateprobe --primitive-solidity) that evalrun plan freezes into each evaluation; HOUSECARL_PRIMITIVE_SOLIDITY or the plan's own flag beats it.
